verdict:
HELD - and this is the one name in the batch where the adjudication changes the disposition of a position we actually own, so the operative instructions come first: HOLD the 940 shares, DO NOT ADD, and keep the 995p/1000p index-boundary alert DISARMED to review-only. The ledger row has already been amended in this direction (alert_below moved to 800.0 with the 1000p line re-specified as review-only because it is anchored to an index rank threshold that moves with the sector); I ratify that amendment and tighten it.

WHY THE ALERT HAD TO COME OFF. The brief's tripwire was 995p, anchored to the rank-111 FTSE threshold as of 13 August. Two things are wrong with it and both are doctrine. First, it sat about 5% from the tape on a name that had just fallen 7.7% in three sessions, with the 52-week low at 976p BELOW the alert - that is not a tripwire, it is a near-certain fire that hands the decision schedule to the tape. Second and more fundamental, it is a beta-carrier gate: the threshold it proxies is a RELATIVE rank, so when the luxury complex sells off together, rank 111's market cap falls too and Burberry can hold its rank at a lower price. The gate can fire while the deletion probability it was built to signal is unchanged - it fires on sector beta, not on the risk. The corrected action level, 800p, is roughly 15x lease-inclusive enterprise value on about GBP248m of forward adjusted operating profit, and I am conditioning even that one: 800p reached in a luxury-complex drawdown is beta, so an add at 800p requires either evidence that the move is idiosyncratic (BRBY's residual against LVMH/Kering/Richemont negative over the window) or the 12 November interims already in hand showing the margin slope.

WHAT THE COURT ACTUALLY SETTLED. The cause-check that put this name in the queue asserted 'it is not noise, and it is not fundamental - it is index-boundary flow.' That sentence was never demonstrated. At rank 102 with the cap comfortably above the rank-111 threshold, no tracker transacts and no arbitrageur front-runs; deletion was a conditional scenario 6-11% away, and mechanically nothing trades until the 18 September effective close in any case. Meanwhile Deutsche Bank cut LVMH in the same three days. The parsimonious explanation is a sector repricing of a high-operational-leverage recovery story trading at 28.8x adjusted EBIT and 40x statutory with no dividend and a 3.1% FCF yield - which IS fundamental. Neither bench could resolve it with data: LSE volume decomposition was unavailable to both, and the official_series luxury proxies (Swiss watch exports, ONS retail) were never pulled. So the cause stays PLAUSIBLE on both sides, and the disposition is the same under either explanation, which is why HOLD/no-add is right regardless.

THE GOOD NEWS IN THE RECORD, WHICH IS REAL. Red pulled the FY26 press release past the 403 and closed the balance-sheet question the trap-verify had left open: cash GBP614m less borrowings GBP511m is GBP103m of NET CASH excluding leases, and free cash flow more than doubled to GBP141m from GBP65m on flat constant-currency revenue. The solvency trap is dead and the margin-recovery slope is actually printing in cash. That is the strongest bull datum in the file and red filed it against its own case - exactly what a red bench is supposed to do when the data says so.

AND THE HONEST SHAPE OF THE UPSIDE. Blue did the work neither the brief nor red did: at the FY23-peak ~20% adjusted operating margin on GBP2.42bn of revenue, adjusted EBIT is about GBP484m; at 15x lease-inclusive EV that is roughly 1790p, +70%. At a 12% interim margin (GBP290m EBIT) the same multiple gives about 977p, -7%. So the recovery option clears +50% only above roughly a 17-18% adjusted operating margin, against 6.6% printed. The roof is real and it is a long way up - that is the correct frame for sizing, and it argues against adding on a calendar event.

WHERE OUR OWN BENCHES ERRED. Red answered a detector list that was not the list the pack dispatched - it responded on nine names absent from the pack while omitting nine that were in it, which is a validator-grade output defect rather than a judgement call. Both benches quoted a drawdown neither re-derived (-21.6% against the pack's -23.7%). Both ignored a detector that had ALREADY RUN and returned a null: consumer_product_heat came back NO_DATA at heat 35 with no retail rank and no social velocity, which is not evidence of deterioration but is the absence of corroboration for the acceleration claim, from the only forward-looking instrument available - and it strengthens red's hard-comp finding materially. Red also over-called the dividend divergence as a multi-venue FIRE; blue's reduction is correct and the detector hit should not enter the knowledge graph as confirmed.

COVERAGE VERSUS DIVERGENCE, ON A HELD NAME. The trap-verify wrote 'Not an orphan - do not reach for FAIR-CARRY... priced by whom answers itself.' That is the permitted use of coverage: it denies the orphan carve-out and the conservative-FV bias correction, and it does not kill anything. But the divergence work was then skipped entirely, and on a name we OWN that is the more serious gap. The gate itself depends on a forward adjusted EBIT of roughly GBP248m, and nowhere in the record does anyone say whose number that is or where the street's range sits. Before the 12 November interims, the file must state consensus FY27 revenue, adjusted operating margin and EBIT with the dispersion, and our number beside it with a mechanism. A gate whose denominator is un-sourced is not a gate, it is a preference.
blue_ruling: PARTIALLY OVERTURNED (red's conclusions largely SUSTAINED, its margins corrected) - blue sustained red's two load-bearing cuts (the index-flow attribution is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause; any post-review re-entry needs a price gate rather than a calendar), corrected red's boundary cushion from 10.9% to 5.8% by re-deriving it at the pack tape of 1050.0p rather than red's stale 1079.5p - a correction that runs FOR the brief and against blue's own bench, filed honestly - recomputed the enterprise value at the lower tape (358.2m shares x 1050.0p = GBP3.76bn plus GBP852m net debt = GBP4.61bn, 28.8x adjusted EBIT of GBP160m, 40.1x statutory GBP115m, FCF GBP141m = 3.1% EV yield), and REDUCED red's multi-venue dividend FIRE to review-flag-at-most on the correct doctrinal test (a board declining to declare for FY26 while management states a forward intention is hierarchical/temporal disclosure, not contradiction - the honesty-ELEVATE boundary is takeaway-divergence, not datum-disclosure). Blue then produced the three findings that actually change desk behaviour: N1, that the armed 995p tripwire is a beta-contaminated near-self-triggering gate; N2, that the pack's own consumer_product_heat detector fired as a NULL (trend_direction NO_DATA, heat 35.0/100, retail_rank and social_velocity both None) and both benches ignored it, so the demand-acceleration leg has no independent corroboration; and N3, that both benches quoted a stale drawdown (-21.6% versus the pack's -23.7%). AUDIT NOTE per BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED: blue's corrections here are recomputations at the pack tape and doctrine rulings, not replacements of a figure red sourced to a primary - the one primary-sourced pair (cash GBP614m, borrowings GBP511m, leases GBP955m, giving GBP103m ex-lease net cash and GBP852m lease-inclusive net debt) is internally consistent and both benches read it the same way, so no re-fetch was owed. Red's balance-sheet work is the best datum in the record and it was filed AGAINST red's own case.
reopen_gates: PRICE, DISARMED TO REVIEW-ONLY (the change that matters): the 995p/1000p index-boundary alert carries NO action. It is anchored to a relative rank threshold that drifts with peers, so it fires on luxury-complex beta while deletion probability is flat, and it sits adjacent to the 976p 52-week low. Review-only, and any review it triggers opens with the sector-residual question, not with the multiple.

PRICE, CONDITIONED ADD LEVEL: 800p (approximately 15x lease-inclusive enterprise value on ~GBP248m forward adjusted operating profit - and that GBP248m must be sourced to a stated street range before the gate is treated as live). ACTIONABLE only if EITHER the move is idiosyncratic (BRBY residual negative against LVMH/Kering/Richemont over the same window) OR the 12 November interims are already in hand with adjusted operating margin slope above 9%. An 800p print delivered by a luxury-complex drawdown is beta and buys a worse thesis, not a cheaper one.

PRINT: 2026-11-12 H1 FY27 interims (yfinance-derived, UNCONFIRMED by company PR - a company PR fixing the date is itself on red's change-my-mind list). The test is adjusted operating margin slope above 9% WITH comparable-sales acceleration against the HARD base: FY26 H1 comps were flat and H2 was +4%, so Q1 FY27's +5% lapped roughly zero and the second half laps +4%. That comp-base discipline is the whole timing finding.

EVENT, NO-BID WINDOW: the FTSE UK quarterly review data date is 2026-09-01 (close), indicative changes 09-02, effective 09-18 (close). We have now PREDICTED this flow, so the value-ladder flow gate forbids bidding into it - no adds before the 18 September close under any branch. And the post-deletion 'mechanical buy window' is a published, crowded, decayed edge (boundary names are listed weekly on free public sites; BRBY itself round-tripped deletion and re-addition in full public view in 2024-25), so it cannot carry an entry on its own.

DATA (corroboration, currently absent): consumer_product_heat returning an actual trend for the brand, or official_series luxury proxies (Swiss watch exports, ONS retail sales) pulled and read. The acceleration leg has NO independent forward read today - the one instrument that ran returned NO_DATA at heat 35 - and the 12 November print is otherwise the first evidence since July.

DIVERGENCE (owed before 2026-11-12, on a held name): state street consensus FY27 revenue, adjusted operating margin and EBIT with the range, and our number beside it with the mechanism. The 800p gate's denominator is currently un-sourced.

SIZE/TAX HOUSEKEEPING: the position was filled 2026-07-01 at ~1065.8p, so the long-term clock does not turn until 2027-07-02 - any trim before that date is short-term and taxed at ordinary rates, which on a ~GBP10k line is immaterial in dollars but should still be stated before any trim is staged. Burberry declared no interim or final FY26 dividend, so there is no distribution carry in the fair value; if reinstated, UK dividends carry no UK withholding for a US individual holder and would be qualified for US purposes - but nothing may be credited to carry until it is declared.
process_findings: *** HELD POSITION - DISPOSITION CHANGE FLAGGED PROMINENTLY *** 940 shares, filled 2026-07-01 at ~1065.8p average (IBKR-confirmed), currently ~GBP10.1k / ~$12.9k, roughly 1.25% of a ~$1.03M book. THE ARMED 995p/1000p INDEX-BOUNDARY ALERT IS DISARMED TO REVIEW-ONLY (beta-carrier self-trigger: the level is derived from a relative index rank that moves with peers). The action level is 800p and it too is now CONDITIONED on idiosyncrasy or on the 12 November evidence. HOLD, NO ADD, no order staged, nothing bid into the 1-18 September FTSE flow.

The ledger row already carries alert_below 800.0 and a note re-specifying the 1000p line as review-only - this adjudication RATIFIES that amendment and adds the idiosyncrasy condition to the 800p level, plus the requirement that its GBP248m forward-EBIT denominator be sourced to a stated street range.

DIVERGENCE-NOT-COVERAGE: no coverage-based kill was made; the trap-verify's use of coverage (denying the FAIR-CARRY orphan carve-out on a fully covered FTSE constituent) is the permitted form. The violation here is by omission and it matters more on a held name: the file states no street number at all, yet the entire add gate hangs on a GBP248m forward adjusted operating profit whose provenance is unstated. Owed before 12 November.

BLUE-CORRECTIONS-AUDITED: blue's corrections are recomputations at the pack tape (cushion 10.9% -> 5.8%; EV GBP4.72bn -> GBP4.61bn; 29.5x -> 28.8x) and one doctrine ruling (dividend divergence reduced), not replacements of a primary figure red sourced - so no re-fetch was owed, and blue filed its most consequential correction against its own bench. The single primary-sourced pair in the record (cash GBP614m / borrowings GBP511m / leases GBP955m) is internally consistent and read identically by both benches.

PROCESS DEFECT (validator-grade): red answered a DETECTORS CONSULTED list that was not the pack's dispatched atlas - it responded on nine names the pack did not carry and omitted nine it did. Same roster-drift family as FIG and INTR. The output validator should diff the consulted list against the dispatched atlas mechanically.

TAPE DISCIPLINE: three tapes appear across the file (brief and red 1079.5p, pack 1050.0p), and both benches quoted a stale dd52 (-21.6% versus the pack's -23.7%, hi52 1376.5, lo52 976.0). A live IBKR quote was permission-denied to every bench. Re-price before any gate is treated as fillable, and note that the GBP/GBp unit trap in the evidence pack (book avg_cost 10.6583 in GBP against a tape in GBp) is a live priceMagnifier hazard on this exact row.

PRINT CLOCK: 12 November interims are ~62 trading sessions from 2026-08-17/18 - outside the print-race window. The nearer dated events are index-calendar, not issuer: 1 September data date (~10 sessions), 18 September effective (~23 sessions). No pre-print reconstruction owed.

TAX: FY26 dividend NOT declared, so no distribution carry sits in the fair value and 'dividend reinstatement' is struck from the thesis. The holding-period clock runs to 2027-07-02; a trim before then is short-term at ordinary rates. If a dividend is reinstated, UK levies no withholding and it would be qualified for a US individual holder - state the after-tax figure at that point, do not assume it now.

CORROBORATION GAP: consumer_product_heat NO_DATA at heat 35 with no retail rank and no social velocity; official_series luxury proxies never pulled; LSE volume decomposition unavailable to both benches. The demand-acceleration leg and the flow-versus-fundamental question are both unmeasured, and the disposition (hold, no add) is deliberately robust to either answer.

kg_candidates.name: index_boundary_gate_beta_contamination
kg_candidates.disposition: ACCEPT - the batch's cleanest instance of the beta-carrier self-trigger rule, and it is the specific case that got an armed alert disarmed on a HELD position. It generalises beyond index rank to any gate whose level is derived from a relative measure.
kg_candidates.one_line: A price alert set as a proxy for index-deletion risk decouples from that risk when the whole cohort sells off, because the rank threshold moves with peers - the gate fires on beta while the actual deletion probability is unchanged.
kg_candidates.fires_on: any tripwire whose level was derived from a relative-rank index threshold rather than an absolute company fact, on a name with sector beta above ~1.5 - re-specify as review-only or attach a relative condition
kg_candidates.evidence_here: BRBY.L: the 995p alert equals the rank-111 cap divided by shares as of 13 August; a luxury-complex selloff lowers rank 111's cap too, so BRBY can hold rank at a lower price while the gate fires. It sat 5.2% from the 1050p pack tape and adjacent-above the 976p 52-week low, on a name that had just fallen 7.7% in three sessions.

packs_to_arm.date_confidence: yfinance-derived, UNCONFIRMED by any company PR - red listed 'a company PR fixing the print date' on its own change-my-mind list, which is the correct instinct. Burberry's reporting cadence (FY26 prelims 2026-05-14, Q1 FY27 trading statement 2026-07-17) supports mid-November for H1 interims. Re-key when the RNS calendar publishes.
packs_to_arm.adjudication: This print, not the FTSE review, is the decision point for the held position. Read in order: (1) H1 FY27 adjusted operating margin and its slope against 6.6% FY26 - above 9% is the reopen bar; (2) comparable sales against the HARD base (H1 FY26 flat, H2 +4%) - a +5%-style headline against a zero base is not acceleration and this is where the July 'HIT' has to be re-earned; (3) free cash flow against GBP141m FY26 and the ex-lease net cash position against GBP103m - the cash slope is the bull's best evidence and must keep printing; (4) Americas revenue and any tariff commentary - Americas +12% is the growth engine on UK/Italy-made goods and origin_mix has null coverage for air-freighted luxury, so the tariff drag is UNCHECKABLE by connector and only management can size it; (5) any dividend declaration - which changes the carry arithmetic and must then be tax-adjusted (no UK withholding, qualified for a US individual); (6) inventory and gross margin against the +530bp FY26 improvement.

branches.MARGIN SLOPE 7-9%, COMPS FLAT AGAINST TH: grinding recovery at 28.8x EV/EBIT - hold the 940 shares, no add, re-arm for FY27 prelims; the position stays immaterial by design.
branches.MARGIN SLOPE BELOW 7% OR COMPS NEGATIVE: the recovery thesis breaks; the position is ~1.25% of book and exitable in a single print - stage the exit decision with the short-term tax clock (to 2027-07-02) stated, not assumed away.
branches.DIVIDEND DECLARED: re-run the carry with the after-tax figure (no UK withholding, qualified dividend for a US individual) and treat reinstatement as a re-court trigger in its own right - a controlled capital-return change is a thesis change.
branches.DELETION FROM THE FTSE 100 ALREADY PRINT: irrelevant to this branch structure by design - the flow event is not the thesis, and the post-deletion buy window is a published, crowded, decayed edge that may not carry an entry by itself.
